newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Two dead, one injured in Czech hospital explosion.
newsitem.headline: Two dead, one injured in Czech hospital explosion.

text.p: Two people were killed and one was seriously injured in an explosion at a hospital in the northeast Czech city of Ostrava on Tuesday, the Czech CTK news agency reported.
The cause of the blast has not yet been determined but Prime Minister Vaclav Klaus told reporters in Prague he could not rule out that terrorism was behind the incident.

The explosion killed two cleaning women and seriously injured a third working in the dermatology unit of the hospital. CTK quoted a hospital source as saying the injured woman would probably lose a leg.
Klaus told reporters waiting outside a working session with ministers: "The investigation is underway now, but at this moment it is not possible to exclude a terrorist motive."
He said he would insist on the "deepest and fastest investigation of all circumstances" surrounding the blast.
